_roles: Each pack colour is swapped for its role colour. primary = logo letters, type, carton lid and base flap, dentist badge (was Deep Navy). accent = the V and the small claims text (was Slate Grey). light = the wave and the V on dark (was Ice Blue). band = the wave's second band (was Soft Silver). White and black (barcode, symbols) never change.

original.name: Original
original.note: The current palette. Deep navy does most of the work, with ice blue and silver.

bright.name: Bright
bright.note: A clear clinical blue with an aqua accent. Fresh, lighter on the eye, and mostly white.

light.name: Light
light.note: The same colour families, lighter. The packs go pale blue and pale tints replace the dark blocks. Softer, closer to premium skincare.

_ranges: ranges: [dark, light] per range. Dark = lid, base flap, badge and the V on white; light = the wave and the V on the dark. Logo letters and type stay the palette's primary. Hues are fixed per range (Joey, 11 Nov): blue core, pink Perio, green Daily, teal/aqua Restore, purple FPD. Options change tone only. In Light the dark blocks become the range's pale tint (second value) with the core type on top, and the first value is the deep tone used for the V and the badge.
_regions: Solid blocks (carton lid and base flap), in texture pixels. A palette with 'solid' recolours these blocks to solid.bg, with the letters in solid.on and the V in solid.v; everywhere else follows the normal roles.
